summary: Euroseas Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the order of two new feeder containerships (1,800 TEU each) at a cost of ~$32.26 million per vessel, with delivery in December 2028 and March 2029. The order is an exercise of options, financed through debt and equity. The filing is a routine business update on fleet expansion, not a special situation such as a merger, acquisition, or restructuring. No deal terms, price premium, or event-driven category applies.
